paragraphs.text:
Feeling like an avenging Ahab who has found his white whale, 
you lift your rifle to your shoulder and fire into the central eye 
of the cold-killer.

The creature is within your rifle’s base range. If you miss, go to 170. 
If you hit, go to 168.
